statement: The NP-hardness of Rectilinear-Upward Planarity Testing holds when the embedding can vary while the linear-time solution holds for upward plane digraphs. Also the testing is trivial if a rectilinear embedding is given. Establishing the complexity of the problem when a planar embedding (neither rectilinear nor upward) is fixed remains an open question. Moreover, our results in the variable embedding setting consider biconnected graphs; extending these results to simply connected instances is a topic for future exploration. Lastly, there is potential for future research in improving the time complexity for series-parallel digraphs.
